args.summary: Following the v2.3.1 production deployment, checkout-api began failing health checks in all regions. Rollback to v2.3.0 (most recent release healthy in production) was executed across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Post-rollback service status is healthy in all regions with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause analysis of v2.3.1 pending; no approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Identified the bad release**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) is unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).
3. **Verified recovery**: Service is now healthy across all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the health check failures, the rollback, and the confirmed healthy state post-rollback.

Note: no change-manager approval was needed since v2.3.0 had been previously healthy in production.
